patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Ocean.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose LinkedIn Sales Navigator only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn’s AI-powered B2B sales tool for network prospecting, Buyer Intent, and InMail — C” rather than Ocean.io's shape. Choose Ocean.io only if your buying job matches “Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from ~$0.063/cr” rather than LinkedIn Sales Navigator's shape. Workflow advantage: LinkedIn Sales Navigator leans shared coverage; Ocean.io leans data-enrichment. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Ocean.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: LinkedIn Sales Navigator is LinkedIn’s AI-powered B2B sales tool for network prospecting, Buyer Intent, and InMail — Core from US$119.99/mo; Advanced Plus for CRM sync.; Ocean.io is Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from ~$0.063/credit, ~$47/mo yearly headline..
- Company-size focus: LinkedIn Sales Navigator (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Ocean.io (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: LinkedIn Sales Navigator-leaning — vs Ocean.io-leaning data-enrichment.
- Researched limits: LinkedIn Sales Navigator — Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info; Ocean.io — Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer.

Limitations — LinkedIn Sales Navigator: Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info; No bulk InMail; messages are individual with monthly InMail credits (50/mo stated on plans); Ocean.io: Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer; Credit minimums and yearly packaging require modeling before comparing to seat tools.

Poor-fit cases: LinkedIn Sales Navigator is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info · Ocean.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer · Avoid LinkedIn Sales Navigator if you actually need Ocean.io's motion (Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
